name: In'youchuu Shuu ~Ryoujoku Rakuen Taimaroku~
original_name: 淫妖蟲 醜 ～凌蝕楽園退魔録～
source:
It's summer, it's a pool, it's a resort!

--The demon-expulsion company, the Black Cat Brigade, received a request from a certain resort swimming pool. Recently, the facility has been plagued by series of rape incidents, targeting mothers and their daughters.

The team is excited to take on a job at a luxury resort pool, somewhere they have never been before. 

Meanwhile, the Tsukishiro sisters are visiting a deserted island to investigate another case. They're trying to get to the bottom of a horrifying incident that occurred in the past......

[translated from [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/tink/inyou_syu/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
夏天来了，去泳池，去度假！

——驱魔公司黑猫支店接到了某座度假泳池的委托。近期，这里接连发生针对母女的性侵案件。

能到从未去过的豪华度假泳池工作，队员们都很兴奋。

与此同时，月白姐妹为了调查另一桩案件，来到一座荒岛。她们要查明的，是过去发生的一起骇人事件的真相……

[译自[url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/tink/inyou_syu/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
